name: Amaranthus caudatus extract
description: Amaranthus caudatus extract (CAS 223747-79-3 ), also sourced and traded as amaranth oil, is a plant-derived ingredient obtained from the seeds of the love-lies-bleeding plant. It delivers moisturizing and antioxidant activity across cosmetic, nutritional, and pharmaceutical formulations. In skincare and haircare products, it functions as a humectant and conditioning agent. The extract supports moisture retention in creams, serums, and leave-on treatments. Nutritional supplement manufacturers incorporate it for its peptide and amino acid content for plant-based protein enrichment. In functional food formulations, it contributes antioxidant activity that can extend shelf stability while supporting a clean-label ingredient profile for various consumer markets. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical developers also evaluate it as a bioactive carrier in softgel and encapsulated formats. Amaranthus caudatus extract is available as a liquid oil extract or dry powder. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly supplied, with some producers offering cold-pressed oil variants for premium personal care applications. Bulk supply is typically available in drums or smaller packaging suited to formulation-scale procurement. This versatile ingredient meets diverse industrial requirements for purity and performance.
